note: Documented + gap-filled Chain Insights graph query recipes. Native traversal forms (BFS/WSHORTEST/KSHORTEST/var-length) on USE topology are bounded per the R2 resource policy and verified against real Memgraph. Merged into the corpus by generate-query-corpus.mjs; facts recipes drive the translator conformance + T0b baselines.

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN to.address AS to_address, t.tx_id AS tx_id, t.block_height AS block_height, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd, t.asset_symbol AS asset_symbol LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Bounded row-select of individual TRANSFER edges by from_address (indexed predicate: address equality on the source endpoint) — fills the facts_transfers_view TRANSFER edge shape (internal epic).

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) WHERE t.tx_id = "8505939-10" RETURN from.address AS from_address, to.address AS to_address, t.event_index AS event_index, t.edge_index AS edge_index, t.amount_usd AS amount_usd LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Bounded row-select of TRANSFER edges by tx_id equality (indexed predicate: the TRANSFER edge's row-level key, since tx_id is an edge property rather than a node id) — fills the tx_id-predicate TRANSFER shape (internal epic).

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address {address: "5CF6Ruq6u7DoF6TYxyaFzEuviWi7tjvJtz19XgPS2b7XDCFM"})-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count, sum(t.amount_usd) AS total_amount_usd LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Bounded count()/sum() aggregate over TRANSFER edges anchored on an address endpoint (indexed predicate required for facts_transfers_view aggregates) — fills the TRANSFER count+sum aggregate shape (internal epic).

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN t.tx_id AS tx_id LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Unbounded TRANSFER row-select with only a LIMIT and no indexed predicate — facts_transfers_view is a full transfer-history table, so a bare LIMIT does not bound the scan; rejected by the StarRocks cost-shape gate (internal epic).

recipes.query: USE facts MATCH (from:Address)-[t:TRANSFER]->(to:Address) RETURN count(t) AS transfer_count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Unbounded TRANSFER aggregate with no indexed predicate — StarRocks-backed aggregate graph queries require an indexed predicate; rejected by the cost-shape gate (internal epic).

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN a.address AS address, a.labels AS labels, a.risk_score AS risk_score, a.risk_level AS risk_level, a.is_exchange AS is_exchange LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live Address projection returning address, labels, risk_score, risk_level, is_exchange

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Live FLOWS_TO edge sample with from/to identity, amount_usd_sum, tx_count, first/last seen timestamps

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.first_seen_timestamp AS first_seen_timestamp, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 50
recipes.description: Top live outflows from one address ordered by amount_usd_sum descending

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, flow.tx_count AS tx_count, flow.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY flow.amount_usd_sum DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Top live FLOWS_TO edges globally ranked by USD sum (no source filter)

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) WITH src, count(dst) AS out_degree, sum(flow.amount_usd_sum) AS total_usd RETURN src.address AS address, out_degree, total_usd ORDER BY out_degree DESC LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Rank source identities by live out-degree and total transferred USD

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address)-[flow:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, CASE WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum IS NULL THEN "unknown" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 100000 THEN "large" WHEN flow.amount_usd_sum >= 10000 THEN "medium" ELSE "small" END AS amount_bucket, flow.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Bucket live flow edges into unknown/large/medium/small by USD amount via CASE

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (m:Address) WHERE m.address STARTS WITH "5Ggf" RETURN m.address AS address, m.network AS member_network LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Prefix search over member Address nodes via STARTS WITH for address completion

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN src.address AS from_address, dst.address AS to_address, 1 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r1.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Direct one-hop FLOWS_TO edge between two named identities (graph_query_batch hop_1)

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[r1:FLOWS_TO]->(mid:Address)-[r2:FLOWS_TO]->(dst:Address) WHERE mid.is_exchange IS NULL RETURN src.address AS from_address, mid.address AS mid_address, dst.address AS to_address, 2 AS hops, r1.amount_usd_sum AS first_amount_usd, r2.amount_usd_sum AS second_amount_usd LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Fixed two-hop FLOWS_TO expansion from a source, skipping exchange intermediates (graph_query_batch hop_2)

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address) RETURN count(a) AS count LIMIT 1
recipes.description: Count of Address nodes in the topology graph

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH p = (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[:FLOWS_TO *1..5]->(b:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN p LIMIT 3
recipes.description: GQL quantified-path form: bind and return any single shortest FLOWS_TO path (1-5 hops) between two anonymous nodes

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH path = (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[:FLOWS_TO *BFS 1..5]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN path LIMIT 5
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): native BFS path between two identities — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH path = (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[:FLOWS_TO *WSHORTEST 5 (r, n | coalesce(r.amount_usd_sum, 1)) total_weight]->(dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) RETURN path, total_weight LIMIT 5
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): weighted shortest path minimizing summed amount_usd_sum weight — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (src:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"}), (dst:Address {address: "5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty"}) WITH src, dst MATCH path = (src)-[:FLOWS_TO *KSHORTEST|3]->(dst) RETURN path LIMIT 3
recipes.description: Direct-Memgraph reference (rejected by hosted path): K shortest (k=3) path alternatives between two identities — retained as a negative/grammar-coverage shape

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) RETURN b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence, l.source_event AS source_event, l.declared_owner AS declared_owner LIMIT 25
recipes.description: Live LINKED ownership-overlay probe for the fixture Address, projecting basis/confidence/source_event/declared_owner provenance

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(owned:Address)-[r:FLOWS_TO]-(b:Address) WHERE owned.address <> b.address AND a.address <> b.address RETURN a.address AS subject_address, owned.address AS linked_via_address, b.address AS counterparty_address, r.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, r.tx_count AS tx_count LIMIT 25
recipes.description: AC11: FLOWS_TO reachability UNIONed over one LINKED hop — actor-level exposure surfaced through an ownership-linked address, not only the subject's own edges

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (a:Address {address: "5GrwvaEF5zXb26Fz9rcQpDWS57CtERHpNehXCPcNoHGKutQY"})-[l:LINKED]-(b:Address) WHERE a.network <> b.network RETURN a.address AS address, a.network AS network, b.address AS linked_address, b.network AS linked_network, l.basis AS basis, l.confidence AS confidence LIMIT 25
recipes.description: AC5: cross-space LINKED probe — the only edge bridging the bittensor and bittensor_evm address-grain networks

recipes.query: USE topology MATCH (owner:Address)-[operation:OPERATED_BY]->(operator:Address {address: "0xdd509c9f91f66a18802ef5b3d54c73b62ea1ca08"}) RETURN owner.address AS owner_address, operation.tx_count AS tx_count, operation.amount_usd_sum AS amount_usd_sum, coalesce(operation.token_standard, "mixed") AS token_standard, operation.last_seen_timestamp AS last_seen_timestamp ORDER BY operation.tx_count DESC LIMIT 10
recipes.description: Canonical point-anchored OPERATED_BY probe (chain-insights#257): given one operator address, its top owners by mediated transfer count. Topology-only edge; anchored to a live high-fan-in operator verified 2026-09-01; zero rows is healthy.
